options.name: 極光玻璃
options.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one beautiful 16:9 production-quality game UI concept screenshot for Breath, a relaxing Arctic seal breathing rhythm game. Direction A: luminous minimalist frosted-glass UI, sophisticated editorial typography, ivory, misty cyan, muted apricot, extremely restrained elegant interface. Most of the screen is a gorgeous underwater ice cathedral with soft volumetric sunbeams, translucent glacier shelf above, distant polar dawn, a cute cream harp seal swimming right towards softly glowing fish, an angler sitting beside an ice hole at upper right. UI must be clearly designed, usable and legible rather than just a painting. Top left small Breath wordmark and chapter '02 / INTO THE BLUE'. Top right two equally clear compact horizontal gauges: lung icon 'OXYGEN 61%' cyan and fish icon 'ENERGY 75%' pale gold. Energy includes three tiny form milestones and label 'FORM II'. Bottom center a subtle typographic instruction 'Follow the light. Breathe with the sea.' Bottom right a beautiful understated frosted rectangular 'HOLD / RELEASE' button and tiny spacebar keycap. Small pause and music controls. No rhythm target circle, no lane of notes, no large central panel, no score spam. Keep 80 percent of the screen for the world. A subtle amber warning variation inset at bottom left labeled 'LOW AIR', with oxygen 18%, softly narrowed vignette, an upward directional marker; this is a small 12% width UI component specimen. Precise alignment, consistent spacing, refined vectorlike UI over painterly 3D artwork. Not a website or marketing landing page. No device frame. Label 'A · AURORA GLASS' discreetly at the bottom edge.

options.name: 極地繪本
options.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. One premium 16:9 game interface reference screenshot for Breath, a soothing Arctic seal breathing-rhythm adventure. Direction B: tactile illustrated storybook UI, warm ivory paper cutouts, hand-inked soft navy outlines, watercolor washes, brass-gold and muted coral accents, charming handcrafted readable labels. Scene: breathtaking layered gouache underwater glacier cathedral in turquoise and deep blue; warm polar dawn and snow above water; one adorable speckled cream seal swimming right toward fish; angler sits by illuminated ice hole above. The UI is an intentional finished layout: upper left small handwritten 'Breath' title and tiny chapter bookmark. Upper right two cream paper tag gauges, equally prominent: a delicately illustrated pair of lungs labeled 'OXYGEN 61%' and a gold fish labeled 'ENERGY 75%'. Under energy a small three-step seal silhouette evolution strip, current 'FORM II'. Both tags have hand-painted fill bars, generous negative space and subtle paper fiber. Bottom center small stitched-paper caption 'Breathe with the tide'. Bottom right cream scalloped paper button 'HOLD / RELEASE' and SPACE keycap. Small music and pause icons. At bottom left, a small component specimen 'LOW AIR 18%' uses warm coral ink and a directional arrow, conveying urgency without horror. Keep at least 80% of screen free for gameplay. No rhythm timing ring or lane of falling notes. No web landing page, no device mockup, no corporate dashboard. Highly polished illustrated indie game UI with consistent typography and spacing. Discreet bottom edge label 'B · POLAR STORYBOOK'.

options.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished 16:9 gameplay UI reference screenshot for Breath, a cozy relaxing seal breathing rhythm game.
